appraisal_events.evidence: il ne se contenta pas de recommander les Jupien à Mme de Villeparisis, à la duchesse de Guermantes, à toute une brillante clientèle... il rendit la place de Jupien de plus en plus lucrative jusqu'à ce qu'il le prît définitivement comme secrétaire... les quelques dames qui avaient résisté... furent... l'objet de terribles représailles.
appraisal_events.explanation: Charlus openly channels his aristocratic influence to enrich and elevate Jupien's trade, recommending him to titled clienteles and punishing those who withhold their patronage -- a socially witnessed rise in Jupien's standing driven entirely by the association.

appraisal_events.evidence: « Ah! c'est un si bon homme que le baron... si bien, si dévot, si comme il faut! Si j'avais une fille à marier... je la donnerais au baron les yeux fermés.» ... « Le baron et Jupien, c'est bien le même genre de personnes.»
appraisal_events.explanation: Françoise sincerely praises both Charlus and Jupien as admirable, respectable men, unknowingly speaking a deeper truth about their kinship; her naive admiration lands ironically for the reader given what has just been revealed.

status_effects.explanation: Jupien's trade is visibly and materially elevated through Charlus's patronage, gaining a fashionable clientele and eventually a secure position as the baron's secretary.
Charlus's ability to command a brilliant clientele toward Jupien and to punish those who resist demonstrates his real, witnessed social dominance over the milieu.
Françoise's sincere praise of Charlus as good, devout, and proper locally elevates him, even as the reader's superior knowledge ironizes the compliment.
Françoise's genuine affection for Jupien and her praise of his character locally elevate him alongside Charlus.

ambiguities: Françoise's remark that Charlus and Jupien are 'the same kind of person' is meant by her as simple praise of shared good character, but reads to the informed reader as unwitting confirmation of their shared identity; this dramatic irony affects how endorsed her admiration should be read.
